name: polar
description: Developer-first merchant of record for SaaS subscriptions, digital products, license keys, and usage billing.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Using production api.polar.sh base URL with sandbox tokens instead of server: 'sandbox'
Not validating Standard Webhooks signatures via validateEvent() from @polar-sh/sdk/webhooks
Exposing POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN in client browser bundles
checklist: Polar SDK initialized with accessToken: process.env.POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN
Webhooks verified with validateEvent(rawBody, headers, process.env.POLAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
